summary: The diff implements most of the required features but has several critical gaps. Most notably, the payment screenshot is stored only as a filename string (not as a Blob in stable storage), the admin credential validation is purely client-side (not backend-validated), and the backend endpoints are protected by principal-based access control rather than session tokens.

missing_requirements.requirement: Payment Screenshot must be stored as a Blob in the backend stable storage — not just a filename/URL.
missing_requirements.reason: The Registration type in main.mo uses paymentScreenshotFileName : Text instead of a Blob field. Payment.tsx passes only screenshot.name (a filename string) to the backend, not the actual file bytes. The constraint explicitly states 'Payment screenshot must be stored as a Blob in the backend stable storage — do not store only a URL.'

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin credentials (VibECX-2K26 / VibECX@2K26) must be validated on the backend, not purely client-side.
missing_requirements.reason: The useAdminLogin mutation in useQueries.ts performs credential validation entirely on the client side with a hardcoded string comparison, never calling a backend adminLogin endpoint. The constraint explicitly states 'Admin credentials must be validated on the backend, not purely client-side.'

missing_requirements.requirement: Both getAdminStats and getAllRegistrations endpoints must reject calls without a valid session token.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend uses principal-based AccessControl (isAdmin check) rather than session token protection. There is no session token mechanism implemented in the backend. The spec requires protection by session token.

missing_requirements.requirement: Payment Screenshot column must show a clickable thumbnail that opens the full image in a preview (lightbox or new tab).
missing_requirements.reason: In AdminDashboard.tsx, the handleScreenshotClick function explicitly comments that screenshots are stored by filename only and shows only the filename in a modal with a note — it cannot show an actual image thumbnail or open a real image preview because no blob data is stored.

hallucinated_features.description: Search bar and event-type filter dropdown added to the AdminDashboard.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not specify a search bar or event-type filter in the admin dashboard. These features were added without being requested.

hallucinated_features.description: A migration.mo module was added as a separate file with a Migration.run function.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention creating a separate migration module. While stable storage persistence was required, the specific approach of a migration.mo file was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Automatic polling of admin data every 30 seconds via refetchInterval.
hallucinated_features.reason: The spec says data should be re-fetched on every dashboard load but does not request automatic polling every 30 seconds.

hallucinated_features.description: Register.tsx calls the backend submitRegistration before navigating to the Payment page.
hallucinated_features.reason: According to frontend-file-summaries.txt, Register.tsx now calls the backend submitRegistration before navigating to the Payment page. The spec only requires FINAL SUBMIT on the Payment page to call the backend, not the Register page.
